transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... I guess I'm here because... I've just been feeling like I let my family down. With taking on this mortgage, and... I don't know. 

It's just... even at work, waiting tables, every small mistake I make... it just feels like it proves I'm useless. Like I deserve whatever happens to me. I don't really know what else to say about it.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It's been... a while, I guess. Maybe a year and eight months? Roughly. Ever since I took on the mortgage for the condo.
Do you still find pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy?

Not really, no. Um... most days, it's just... I don't know. There's just this heavy, empty feeling in my chest. Even at work, you know, I'm just going through the motions. Carrying plates, smiling at people... but it's just because I'm supposed to. Not because I actually feel anything good. It's just... empty.
Have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself?

No, I... I don't have a plan or anything like that. I wouldn't do that. It's just... sometimes, when I'm lying there in the dark, before I have to get up for an early shift... I just kind of think... maybe it would be easier if I just didn't wake up. Then I wouldn't have to... keep messing everything up. But I wouldn't actually do anything.
Do you still enjoy spending time with friends and family?

Not much. Um... I used to text my brother a lot after my shifts, but... I don't know. Now I just let his messages sit there. I don't really feel the pull to answer him. It's... yeah. It's the same with people at work, really. I used to joke around with the regulars, but lately I just... keep my face straight. I just say what I have to say, and that's it.
Have you experienced any significant changes in your appetite or sleep patterns?

I guess... my eating's been kind of all over the place. Um... some weeks I barely touch the staff meal at work. Other nights... I don't know, I get home and just eat whatever's in the kitchen. Just to... feel settled, I guess. Sleep is... yeah, it's about the same.
Have you had a period of at least two weeks where you felt better, with less of these empty and useless feelings, since you started feeling this way about a year and eight months ago?

Yeah, um... I guess there was a stretch. Maybe a few weeks where... I wasn't feeling quite as down. Getting through my shifts was a bit easier. 

But... I don't know. It's not like everything was fine. I was still... I still heard the whispering at the condo. And I still had that feeling of being watched... especially when I was looking over my mortgage paperwork. So... yeah.
Can you tell me more about the whispering you mentioned earlier, what did it sound like?

It's... just a voice. Um... usually when it's quiet. Like if I'm closing up the restaurant, or... just sitting by myself at the condo. 

It's low. Sometimes it just says my name. Other times it... it whispers that I'm going to lose everything. It sounds real. I usually... I look around to see if someone's there. But there isn't.
How long have you been hearing the whispering voice?
I don't know... a while now. Um... maybe a year and four months? Give or take. Both the voice and... that feeling of being watched. They started around the same time.
Have the whispering voice and the feeling of being watched been present continuously since they started, or have they come and gone?
Um... they don't really go away. They're just... always kind of there.
Have you experienced any other unusual perceptions or thoughts that seem real to you, besides the whispering voice and feeling of being watched?
No... I don't think so. Just... just the voice and the feeling. Nothing else really.
Do you think the whispering voice is real, or do you think it's just your mind playing a trick on you?
I... I don't know. It feels real. But... I don't really know.
Do you believe the whispering voice is telling the truth when it says you're going to lose everything or that you're useless?

I... I guess so. It just... I can't really shake this feeling I have. Like... the bank, and sometimes my manager at work... they're just watching for me to mess up. Even when someone shows me it was just a normal paperwork thing, or a regular register error... I still feel it. So... yeah. I kind of believe it.
Do you find it difficult to organize your thoughts or express them clearly to others?
No... I don't think so. I mean, I think I make sense when I talk. I haven't really noticed a problem with that.
Do you think the bank or your manager at work are actually plotting against you or is it just a feeling you have?

I don't know if it's a plot. I just... like I said, I can't shake the feeling. Even when people try to show me it was just a normal paperwork thing, or a standard register error at the restaurant... I still feel like they're watching me. Waiting for me to mess up. So... I don't know. It feels real to me.
Do you think the whispering voice is coming from inside your mind or from an external source?

I don't know... it sounds real. Like, when I'm closing up at the restaurant, or just sitting alone in my condo... I'll hear it. It's a low voice. It says my name, or whispers that I'm going to lose everything. It sounds like it's right there. I even turn around to check sometimes... but nobody's there.
Do you think the bank or your manager at work are trying to harm you in any way?

I don't know about harm... I just... like I said before, I can't shake the feeling that they're watching for me to mess up. The bank, my manager... even when people show me it was just a normal paperwork thing, or a register error... I just feel it.
Do you think someone is intentionally trying to harm you?
No... I mean, like I just said, I don't think so. I haven't noticed anyone trying to actually hurt me. Just... what I told you before.
Do you think that events or conversations of others are specifically related to you?
No, not really. I mean, people talk about their own stuff. I don't... I don't think they're talking about me.
Do you think that things you see or hear on TV, radio, or read in the newspaper are specifically about you?
No. I just watch the news sometimes. It's just normal TV.
